I have resolved the issue in [json.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xa8xefet/django/db/models/fields/json.py):

- Added [`HasKeyLookup.compile_json_path_final_key()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xa8xefet/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L175-L177) so that [`HasKeyLookup.as_sql()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xa8xefet/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L179-L210) always compiles the final right-hand side key as a JSON object key (`.%s`) rather than an array index (`[%s]`) when the key is numeric.
- Added [`HasKeyOrArrayIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xa8xefet/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L257-L259) and updated [`KeyTransformIsNull`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xa8xefet/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L393-L414) and [`KeyTransformExact`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-xa8xefet/django/db/models/fields/json.py#L446-L483) to use it so array index transforms continue to work for `isnull` and `exact=None` lookups on SQLite and Oracle.
